races.name: Why Bet Elsewhere, David Lucas Bookmakers Maiden Hurdle (GBB Race)

verdicts.rp: by Richard Russell: Some interesting hurdling debutants are arguably headed by bumper winners BANDE ORGANISEE and All About Trev.

races.name: Guaranteed Odds At David Lucas Bookmakers Novices' Hurdle (GBB Race) (Div 1)

verdicts.rp: by Richard Russell: The Ascot bumper contested by SEA THE DAY continues to work out and he's suggested to win first time up over hurdles.

races.name: Racing To School Reaches 25 Years Juvenile Hurdle (GBB Race)

verdicts.rp: by Steve Boow: The pick on hurdles form is SACRE CHEF , who ran well in the Wensleydale last time. Magical Merlot is second choice.

races.name: McCarthy Construction Novices' Hurdle (GBB Race) (Div 2)

verdicts.rp: by Richard Russell: This could boil down to a shootout between Moltezuma and HIDDEN MOUNTAIN.

races.name: Treble Odds L15s At David Lucas Handicap Chase (GBB Race)

verdicts.rp: by Richard Russell: A really interesting handicap that should be throwing up winners in the weeks to come and it's only a narrow vote that goes to WILSTAR.

races.name: Albert Bartlett Triple Crown Series Handicap Hurdle (Qualifier)

verdicts.rp: by Emily Weber: A few potential improvers on show and preference is for MAJEUR ALLEN on his first start for Dan Skelton. Mulinas is next best.

races.name: Happy 80th Birthday Pamela Hall Handicap Chase (GBB Race)

verdicts.rp: by Alistair Jones: Cases can be made for plenty of these. PATRIOTIK hinted at a return to form on his chase debut and this race is more suitable.

races.name: Ascot Shared Ownership Weekend Handicap Hurdle

verdicts.rp: by Richard Austen: Most are in serious contention. MOVEIT LIKE MINNIE is surely capable of an Ascot win, judged on a string of good efforts in defeat here.

races.name: David Lucas Best Prices Welsh Sport Handicap Hurdle

verdicts.rp: by Alistair Jones: Useful Flat performer NORTHWEST PASSAGE (nap) did it very easily on last week's handicap debut as a hurdler. He's 6lb well in.

races.name: Free 5 Pound Bet At David Lucas Open NH Flat Race (GBB Race)

verdicts.rp: by Alistair Jones: Hurricane Mick is of clear interest and so too LORD MAX , as a half-brother to Sober Glory.

races.name: All Weather Championship Is Back Amateur Jockeys' Handicap

verdicts.rp: by Paul Smith: It could be worth chancing a revival from AGE OF TIME . Shielas Well and class-dropping Maith Mar Or are others of note.

races.name: Irishinjuredjockeys.com Nursery Handicap

verdicts.rp: by Dave Stephens: Preference is for INVINCIBLE IRISH who may be able to shed the maiden tag dropped back in distance.

races.name: Now Racing Every Wednesday At Dundalk Handicap (0-60)

verdicts.rp: by Alan Hewison: On 8lb better terms, SOVEREIGN BANTER can reverse recent C&D form with Surpass And Shine.

races.name: AWC Finals Day At Newcastle 26th March Maiden Fillies' Stakes (GBB/GBBPlus Race) (Div 1)

verdicts.rp: by David Moon: The vote goes to LADY PHILLIPS , who had a close call on her Leicester debut last month and was runner-up again at Bath last time.

races.name: AWC Finals Day At Newcastle 26th March Maiden Fillies' Stakes (GBB/GBBPlus Race) (Div 2)

verdicts.rp: by David Moon: This can go to ZHURI , who has shown clear promise in two runs this autumn, including a strong-finishing second at Yarmouth last month.

races.name: BAR 1 Betting 'Safer Gambling Week' Rated Race

verdicts.rp: by Dave Stephens: The C&D maiden winner ALISSAM was too keen over 1m here last time but might settle better dropped back in distance.

races.name: AWC Season 14 Selling Handicap

verdicts.rp: by Paul Smith: Kalamunda shaped better at Chelmsford last time and can go well but DOVEY MOON 's latest run is excusable and he may be the answer.

races.name: Irish Stallion Farms EBF (C & G) Maiden

verdicts.rp: by Dave Stephens: BRIDGETOWN BOY looks the type to improve plenty from his debut effort here over 7f with the step up 1m almost certain to suit.

races.name: AWC Trials Day - Lingfield 2nd January 2027 Nursery

verdicts.rp: by Paul Smith: Perfect Hope should go well once more but ALFEY MOON has threatened better and this could be his day.

races.name: Irish Stallion Farms EBF Fillies Maiden

verdicts.rp: by Alan Hewison: Second to a smart filly here in September, CASTILIAN QUEEN looks the one to beat, providing she stays this longer trip.

races.name: All Weather Championship Handicap

verdicts.rp: by Paul Smith: Secret Santa and TREMOLO are returning from breaks but retain considerable potential. Asuka is feared despite his wide draw.

races.name: Christmas Party Nights At Dundalk Stadium Apprentice Handicap

verdicts.rp: by Alan Hewison: Some value may be had in TERO D'ROSA , returning to the AW after a decent turf season, having shaped well over C&D this time last year.

races.name: Midnite It's Actually Pretty Good Handicap

verdicts.rp: by David Moon: Top of the list is dual course winner BARRY THE WORM (nap) , who was second here in his last two runs.

races.name: Safer Gambling Week 2026 Handicap (0-60)

verdicts.rp: by Dave Stephens: 1.5l separated Doctor Grace and YOUNG CHURCHILL (nap) over C&D last week but the latter didn't get a clear run so may gain revenge.

races.name: Midnite Built Different Handicap

verdicts.rp: by David Moon: The vote goes to dual Wolverhampton winner SAN JUANITO , who won at Southwell two weeks ago and remains well treated on his old form.
